get.description: The whole org structure of the workspace in one response: departments, positions and the assignment of active people. Any active member may read it. Deactivated people, agents and people with neither a membership nor a position are left out of people; a lead who is not active is reported as null. chat_id of a department is given only to members of that chat (has_chat tells the others a chat exists). The response carries ETag "org-{version}"; a request with a matching If-None-Match gets 304 without a body. Until the server announces the org_structure feature the route answers 501 not_implemented.

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: The ETag of the cached structure, "org-{version}".

200.description: The current structure.

post.description: Creates a department. Needs org.manage or members.manage (403 forbidden otherwise). members with primary true move the person's primary department here and drop the membership in the previous primary one; additional departments are not touched. primary false adds the department as an additional one. A lead who is not among members becomes an additional member. Only people (not agents) may be members (422 org_invalid, details.field actor_id). Depth is limited to 8 levels (422 org_depth_exceeded), the workspace to 500 departments and a person to 10 additional departments (409 org_limit_reached). Names are unique among siblings ignoring case (409 org_name_taken). Writes of the org structure are limited to 120 a minute per person (429 rate_limited). Emits org.updated.

201.description: The new department and the org version after the write.

patch.description: Renames a department, moves it under another parent (parent_id null — to the top level) or sets its lead (lead_actor_id null — no lead). A lead outside the department becomes an additional member. A parent that is the department itself or its descendant gets 409 org_cycle. expected_version is the department's version (409 org_version_conflict when stale). Needs org.manage or members.manage. Emits org.updated.

200.description: The department and the org version after the write.

delete.description: Deletes a department. Its subdepartments move to its parent. Primary members move to members_to (by default the parent); with none, or without a parent, a person's oldest additional department becomes primary, otherwise the person is left without a department. Additional memberships are dropped. The department chat stays, only the link is removed. Past requests to the department keep their label. Needs org.manage or members.manage. Emits org.updated.

parameters.name: members_to
parameters.description: Department id that becomes the primary department of the primary members, or none. Absent means the parent. It must not be the deleted department or one of its descendants (422 org_invalid).

post.description: Moves a department one place up or down among its siblings. The first manual move sets sort_key for all siblings (until then they go by name). Moving the first one up or the last one down changes nothing. Needs org.manage or members.manage. Emits org.updated when the order changes.

200.description: The department and the org version after the move; siblings changed too.

put.description: Adds a person to a department or changes the kind of membership. primary true moves the person's primary department here; the previous primary one becomes additional with keep_previous true, otherwise that membership is dropped. primary false makes it an additional department; turning the primary department into an additional one promotes the person's oldest other additional department, if any. Needs org.manage or members.manage. Emits org.updated.

200.description: The person's assignment and the org version after the write.

delete.description: Removes a person from a department. When it was the primary one, the oldest additional department becomes primary. When the person led the department, the lead is cleared in the same write. Removing a person who is not a member changes nothing. Needs org.manage or members.manage. Emits org.updated.

put.description: Sets the whole assignment of one person at once: primary department, additional departments and position. Departments the person leads but is no longer a member of lose their lead. additional_department_ids must not contain the primary one and needs a primary one (422 org_invalid). expected_org_version, when given, must equal the current org version (409 org_version_conflict). Needs org.manage or members.manage. Emits org.updated.

200.description: The person's assignment and the org version after the write.

post.description: Mass assignment for up to 200 people in one transaction and one org.updated event. Fields left out are not touched. primary_department_id moves the primary department as setDepartmentMember with keep_previous false; add_department_id adds an additional department (people for whom it is already primary keep it as primary); position_id sets the position, null clears it. All people must be active people of the workspace (422 org_invalid, details.field actor_ids). Needs org.manage or members.manage.

200.description: The assignments of the people and the org version after the write.

post.description: Adds a position to the directory. Names are unique ignoring case (409 org_name_taken); at most 300 positions (409 org_limit_reached). Needs org.manage or members.manage. Emits org.updated.

201.description: The new position and the org version after the write.

post.description: Adds several positions at once, for «Должности из подписей профилей». Names that already exist (ignoring case) or repeat in the request are skipped, not rejected. One org.updated event. Needs org.manage or members.manage.

200.description: Created and skipped names and the org version after the write.

patch.description: Renames a position. expected_version is the position's version (409 org_version_conflict when stale). Past requests to the position keep the old label. Needs org.manage or members.manage. Emits org.updated.

200.description: The position and the org version after the write.

delete.description: Deletes a position; people who held it are left without one. Past requests to the position keep their label. Needs org.manage or members.manage. Emits org.updated.

get.description: «Должности из подписей профилей»: distinct profile titles of active people (trimmed, compared ignoring case) that do not match a position yet, with the people who carry each, most frequent first. After createPositions the client may assign the new positions to them with assignPeopleOrg. Needs org.manage or members.manage.

200.description: Suggestions, at most 200.

post.description: «Создать чат отдела»: creates a private group named after the department with all active people of the department and its subdepartments, as an ordinary group creation (the same member limit, chat.created and member.joined events). The caller owns the chat, the lead is its administrator. Allowed to the department lead and to holders of org.manage or members.manage (403 forbidden otherwise). 409 department_chat_exists when the department already has a chat, archived included. Emits org.updated.

201.description: The chat, the department with the link and the org version.

put.description: «Привязать чат»: links an existing group. It must be a group (not a direct chat or a channel), not archived, and the caller must be its owner or administrator (422 department_chat_invalid otherwise). 409 department_chat_exists when the chat is linked to another department or this department already has a chat. Allowed to the lead and to holders of org.manage or members.manage. Emits org.updated.

200.description: The department with the link and the org version.

delete.description: Removes the link between the department and its chat; the chat stays as it is. Allowed to the lead and to holders of org.manage or members.manage. Emits org.updated.

get.description: Active people of the department and its subdepartments who are not members of the department chat, those who left on their own included. Only for a member of the chat who may add members there and is the lead or holds org.manage or members.manage (403 forbidden); 404 department_not_found when the department has no chat.

200.description: The missing people.

Realtime message.saved goes to the person's own sessions only. At most 5000 readable saves per person: over it the reply is 409 saved_limit_reached and nothing is removed; saves hidden by lost access do not count. All rows of a person, hidden ones included, are capped at three times the limit (409 saved_storage_full).

post.description: Sends a request message to the chat: a question with answer buttons addressed to some members. Any member who may write to the chat may send one (the same check as createMessage). The audience is turned into a fixed list of people at the moment of sending: the author, agents and deactivated people are left out, and whoever joins the chat later is not asked. The audiences department and position need the org_structure feature (422 request_audience_unavailable without it) and requests.address_groups (403 request_audience_forbidden). Requests go to the main chat feed only, not into threads. A replay with the same client_msg_id and the same content returns the original message (200); the same key with other content gets 409 idempotency_conflict.

200.description: The original request message for an idempotent replay.

201.description: Request message created; it carries request and request_viewer.

get.description: «Ждут вас»: requests addressed to the current person in chats they can read now (member and active, chat not archived, message not deleted). state=waiting lists open requests without the person's answer: those with a due date first (earliest due first), then the rest, newest first. state=answered lists open requests the person has answered, latest answer first. Closed requests are not listed.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque next_cursor of the previous page.

200.description: The request and the viewer state.

put.description: Sets or changes the current person's answer; the comment is set by the same call. Only a recipient who is still a member may answer (403 not_member otherwise). A first answer after the due date is accepted while the request is open and is marked late. An answer may be changed before the due date, or while the request is open when it has none (409 request_change_too_late otherwise). Repeating the same answer and comment changes nothing and emits no events.

200.description: The request and the viewer state after the answer.

get.description: Who answered what. Only the author and, while they hold the role, a chat owner or admin or a workspace moderator with chats.moderate who is in the chat; everyone else gets 403. Access is checked on every call. Without filter all recipients are listed: waiting first, then answered, latest answer first.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque next_cursor of the previous page.

200.description: One page of answers with counts for the tabs.

post.description: The author reminds recipients who have not answered. Not sooner than 2 hours after the previous manual reminder (429 request_remind_too_soon with Retry-After) and at most 5 times per request (409 request_limit_reached). A person gets at most 10 request reminders a day from all requests: the rest are not sent but are counted in reminded.

200.description: How many people were reminded and when the next reminder is allowed.

post.description: Closes the request: no more answers. The author or a chat owner or admin (closed_reason author or moderator). Closing a closed request changes nothing and returns its state.

200.description: The closed request and the viewer state.

put.description: Creates the current person's reminder about a message they can read, or moves the existing one: one reminder per message and person. Moving a fired reminder makes it pending again. remind_at must be at least 1 minute and at most 365 days ahead (422 reminder_invalid). At most 500 pending reminders per person (409 reminder_limit_reached). Nobody else learns about the reminder.

200.description: The existing reminder was moved or its note changed.

delete.description: «Готово» or «Убрать»: removes the person's reminder about the message. Repeating it also returns 204.

204.description: The message has no reminder of the person.

get.description: The person's reminders. state=pending is ordered by remind_at, soonest first; state=fired by fired_at, latest first. The message is included only while the person can read it.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque next_cursor of the previous page.

200.description: One page of reminders; next_cursor continues it.

get.description: The person's reminders about messages of one chat, for the bell in the feed. Kept apart from Message so the feed stays the same for every reader.

200.description: Reminders of the person in the chat.

put.description: Moves a reminder or changes its note by id: for reminders whose message was deleted (message_id is null). Someone else's id gets 404. Same rules as setMessageReminder.

200.description: The reminder after the change.

delete.description: Removes a reminder by id. Repeating it, or someone else's id, also returns 204.

204.description: The person has no reminder with this id.

post.description: Creates a task message in the chat feed (never in a thread). Any member who may write to the chat may create one (the same check as createMessage). The server builds body from the title and the description (title, then an empty line and the description when it is not empty) with body_format markdown, so search, agents and older clients see the task as text. The responsible person and the assignees of items must be active people who are members of the chat (422 task_assignee_invalid); a task may be set on oneself. The department and position assignees need requests.address_groups (403 task_audience_forbidden) and the org_structure feature (422 task_invalid, field assignee.kind, otherwise); they become a queue of candidates: a snapshot of the active people of the department (with subdepartments, primary and additional members) or of the position who are members of the chat, the author included. No candidates gets 422 task_audience_empty, more than 100 gets 422 task_too_many_candidates. source_message_id must be a message of the same chat, in the feed or in a thread (422 task_invalid otherwise). At most 300 open tasks per chat and 500 open tasks per author (409 task_limit_reached). A replay with the same client_msg_id and the same content returns the original message (200); the same key with other content gets 409 idempotency_conflict.

200.description: The original task message for an idempotent replay.

201.description: Task message created; it carries task.

get.description: Tasks of the chat for members of the chat (403 not_member otherwise). state=open lists open and in_progress tasks: those with a due date first (earliest first), then those without, newest first. state=done and state=canceled are ordered by status_changed_at, latest first. counts are the same for every state and page: open tasks of the chat, open tasks of the reader (responsible, assignee of an open item or candidate of an open queue) and those of them that are hot (overdue or due within 24 hours).

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque next_cursor of the previous page.

200.description: One page of task messages with the counts of the chat.

get.description: The reader's tasks from all chats they can read now (member and active, chat not archived, message not deleted). role=assigned: tasks where the reader is responsible, the assignee of an open item or a candidate of a queue nobody has taken. role=authored: tasks the reader created. state=open lists open and in_progress tasks, due date first (earliest first, overdue on top), then without one, newest first; state=done lists tasks done or canceled in the last 7 days, latest first («Готово за 7 дней»). Older closed tasks are in listChatTasks.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque next_cursor of the previous page.

200.description: One page of the reader's tasks.

get.description: The task message. Anyone who can read the message may call it; others, and messages that are not tasks, get 404 task_not_found.

200.description: The task message with task.

patch.description: Changes the title, the description, the due date, the reminder before it or the responsible person. The author while a member of the chat, or a chat owner or admin or a workspace moderator with chats.moderate who is in the chat (403 task_forbidden otherwise). A new title or description rebuilds body and sets edited_at (message.updated); other changes emit task.updated. A canceled or done task cannot be changed (409 task_status_invalid). Another expected_version gets 409 task_version_conflict with the current task in details.task.

200.description: The task message after the change.

put.description: Moves the task between open, in_progress, done and canceled. Allowed moves: open ↔ in_progress, open or in_progress → done, done → open, open or in_progress → canceled, canceled → open; any other gets 409 task_status_invalid. in_progress, done and done → open: the author, the responsible person and chat admins; canceled and canceled → open: the author and chat admins (403 task_forbidden otherwise). Setting the current status again changes nothing and emits no events.

200.description: The task message after the change.

post.description: «Взять себе»: a candidate of a queue who is still an active member of the chat becomes the responsible person (403 not_member for one who left, 403 task_forbidden for someone who is not a candidate). When somebody has taken it already: 409 task_already_taken with the current task in details.task.

200.description: The task message with the reader as the responsible person.

post.description: Adds a checklist item: the author, the responsible person and chat admins. At most 30 items (409 task_limit_reached). Without position the item goes last; with it the items from that position move down.

patch.description: Changes the text, the assignee or the position of an item, or marks it done or not done. The author, the responsible person and chat admins may do everything; the assignee of the item may only change done of their own item (403 task_forbidden otherwise).

200.description: The task after the change.

delete.description: Removes an item: the author, the responsible person and chat admins. Repeating it also returns 204.

204.description: The task has no item with this id.

post.description: «Напомнить»: the author or a chat admin reminds the responsible person (the candidates of a queue nobody has taken). Not sooner than 2 hours after the previous one (429 task_nudge_too_soon with Retry-After) and at most 5 times per task (409 task_limit_reached). A person gets at most 10 such reminders a day from all tasks; the rest are recorded but send no push.

200.description: When the next reminder is allowed.

get.description: «Ждут вас» as one list: open requests waiting for the reader's answer (the same rows as listRequestInbox with state=waiting) and open tasks where the reader is responsible, the assignee of an open item or a candidate of a queue nobody has taken, in chats they can read now. With the message_polls feature also open polls with a due date the reader may vote in and has not voted in yet (polls without a due date never wait). Items with a due date come first (earliest first, overdue on top), then those without one, newest first; the order is stable across kinds, so pages never repeat or skip an item. kind narrows the list; kind=polls on a server without message_polls gets 422. Servers without message_tasks do not have this route: clients use listRequestInbox there. listRequestInbox stays for older clients and the «Отвечено» tab.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque next_cursor of the previous page; only valid with the same kind.

200.description: One page of the inbox; next_cursor continues it.

post.description: Sends a poll message to the chat feed (never into a thread). Any member who may write to the chat may send one (the same check as createMessage); a poll obliges nobody, so there is no permission of its own. The server builds body from the question and the options («Опрос: {question}», an empty line, then one line «— {option}» per option) with body_format plain, so search, agents and older clients see the poll as text. The question is 1–300 characters, there are 2–10 options of 1–100 characters without repeats ignoring case (422 poll_invalid with details.field otherwise). due_at is optional: at least 10 minutes and at most 90 days ahead; without it the poll stays open until someone closes it. At most 100 open polls per chat and 200 per author (409 poll_limit_reached), 30 new polls a minute per person (429 rate_limited). An archived chat gets 409 chat_archived. A replay with the same client_msg_id and the same content returns the original message (200); the same key with other content gets 409 idempotency_conflict.

200.description: The original poll message for an idempotent replay.

201.description: Poll message created; it carries poll and poll_viewer.

get.description: The poll of a message and the current person's view of it. Anyone who can read the message now (an active member, the chat not archived, the message not deleted) may call it; others get 404 poll_not_found. viewer.counts is set only when the person may see the results (voted, the author, or the poll is closed).

200.description: The poll and the viewer state.

patch.description: Edits the question of a poll (decision 12 of phase 6.7): the server rebuilds body from the new question and the unchanged options, writes a message revision and sets edited_at («изм.» on the card). The options, multiple, anonymous and due_at never change, and the votes stay. Only the author while an active member of the chat (403 forbidden otherwise; others who cannot read the poll get 404 poll_not_found). An open poll only: a closed poll gets 409 poll_closed, because its result answers the question as it was asked. An archived chat gets 409 chat_archived. expected_version is MessagePoll.version; another one gets 409 version_conflict. The same question changes nothing. Emits message.updated and poll.updated with the new version. updateMessage refuses poll messages (422 validation_failed). 120 changes a minute per person (429 rate_limited).

200.description: The poll message after the edit, with poll and poll_viewer.

put.description: Casts or changes the current person's vote. Only a person who is an active member of the chat (403 not_member otherwise; agents cannot vote), while the poll is open (409 poll_closed) and the chat is not archived (409 chat_archived). options is one index unless the poll allows several answers (422 poll_invalid). In an ordinary poll the call sets or replaces the vote. In an anonymous poll only the first vote is accepted and any other gets 409 poll_vote_final: the server keeps no link between the person and the options, so it cannot change the vote. Repeating the same vote changes nothing and emits no events. The request body is never written to request logs or the audit. 120 votes a minute per person (429 rate_limited).

200.description: The poll and the viewer state after the vote.

delete.description: «Отменить голос»: removes the current person's vote from an open ordinary poll. Retracting when there is no vote changes nothing and returns 204.

actor_id.description: Who caused the event. null when the server must not or cannot tell: always for poll.updated (a vote must not reveal the voter) and for poll.notified with kind closed_expired, which the server sends by itself. Clients never rely on it being set.

data.description: Event payload. For message.created, message.updated and message.deleted it is the message in the shape of the REST feed (components/schemas/Message: files with metadata and no links, thread_reply_count, mentioned_actor_ids, blocks, agent_provenance and request when present; never request_viewer, which is per reader), read when the event is delivered, plus silent on message.created and thread_root_reply_count on thread replies. A frame that would exceed the frame limit (WS_MAX_FRAME_BYTES) is never sent as is: its data becomes a stub with truncated: true — for message.* the Message shape with an empty body, no files and no blocks, for other events only their short scalar fields — and the client loads the record by REST. The data of request.* and reminder.* events is described by the RequestAssignedEvent … ReminderFiredEvent definitions: it never carries message text, notes, comments or who answered what. The data of org.updated is OrgUpdatedEvent: only the new version and a reason, never names or people. message.* frames of a poll carry poll (MessagePoll: never the counts of an open poll) and never poll_viewer; the data of poll.* events is PollUpdatedEvent, PollVoteUpdatedEvent and PollNotifiedEvent: never anyone's choice but the recipient's own, and no choice at all in an anonymous poll. The data of actor.away.updated and away.substitute.* is ActorAwayUpdatedEvent, AwaySubstituteAssignedEvent and AwaySubstituteRemovedEvent: never the auto-reply text or mute_push. Frames are encoded without HTML escaping.

RealtimeRequestAutoRemindedEventV1.description: data of request.auto_reminded, sent only to the author (subject_id is the message id): the outcome of the automatic reminder, also when everyone has answered (reminded is 0). Triggers a push.

RealtimeReminderFiredEventV1.description: data of reminder.fired, sent only to the owner's devices (subject_id is the reminder id). late: fired more than 15 minutes after remind_at. Triggers a push unless it is more than 6 hours late.

RealtimeOrgUpdatedEventV1.description: data of org.updated, sent to the whole workspace (chat_id null, subject_id is the organization id) once per transaction that changed the org structure, including deactivating or reactivating a person who had a membership, a position or led a department. Carries no content: the client reloads GET /api/v1/org with If-None-Match (after about 500 ms, to merge bursts) and drops the event when version is not greater than the cached one.

Never carries the title, the description or item texts. kinds: assigned — the new responsible person (creation, change); unassigned — the former responsible person, no push, removes the task from «Ждут вас» on every device; item_assigned — the assignee of an item; offered — each candidate of a new queue; taken — the author, a candidate took the task; nudged — the responsible person or the candidates, «Напомнить»; due_soon — the same, one hour before due_at; overdue — the responsible person and the author; due_changed — the responsible person; completed — the author, done by someone else; reopened — the responsible person, done → open by someone else. AgentConfirmationMode.description: auto runs the action by itself; confirm waits for a person's approval.

AgentConfirmationPolicy.description: Confirmation of each built-in write tool (post_message, reply_in_thread, add_reaction, post_card, update_card, start_collection, schedule_followup, remember, send_direct_message). A request may name only the tools it changes; responses name all of them with the mode Core enforces. Tools in the server floor cannot be set to auto.

description.description: Instructions. For a recipe agent leave empty to get the catalog instructions in `locale`.

locale.description: Language of recipe instructions Core fills in (ru, en; falls back to en). Defaults to Accept-Language.

read_chat_ids.description: Chats the agent reads. With write_chat_ids it replaces chat_ids by their union; a list that is omitted keeps its current value.
Chats the agent reads. With write_chat_ids it replaces chat_ids by their union; a list that is omitted keeps its current value.

acknowledge_loosened.description: With enabled=true, confirms the actions agent_confirmation_loosened listed.

card_message_id.description: Chat card mirroring this confirmation in the run's chat, when one was posted.

dry_run.description: A write step of a dry run that was only previewed.

embedding_model.description: Embedding model for the knowledge base; empty disables embeddings. Not available for anthropic.

embedding_data_sharing_approved.description: Explicit consent to send document text to the provider for embeddings.

embedding_model.description: Embedding model for the knowledge base; empty disables embeddings. Not available for anthropic.

embedding_data_sharing_approved.description: Explicit consent to send document text to the provider for embeddings.

embedding_model.description: Embedding model for the knowledge base; empty disables embeddings. Not available for anthropic.

embedding_data_sharing_approved.description: Explicit consent to send document text to the provider for embeddings.

headers.description: Replaces encrypted headers; an empty object clears them. Omit to keep them unchanged.

tool_confirmation.description: Effective mode of every allowed tool when it changes data.

allow_private_network.description: The connection may reach listed internal addresses and plain HTTP; link-local and cloud metadata addresses stay forbidden.

allowed_private_cidrs.description: Internal ranges the endpoint may resolve to (from the operator allowlist). Empty means public addresses only.

arguments.description: Tool arguments. Required for writes that need a person's approval; Core executes the approved call with exactly these arguments.

preview.description: Server-enforced instruction to return a simulated result without calling the external MCP tool.

confirmation.description: Present when a person must approve the write first. The runtime must not call the tool; Core executes it after approval.

allowed_tools.description: Must be assignable on the connection and, once Core knows the catalog, offered by the server.

require_write_confirmation.description: Calls to tools that are not read-only wait for a person's approval; Core then executes them. Omitted means true; a connection that requires confirmation forces it on.

confirmation_policy.description: Per-tool override of require_write_confirmation for allowed tools. A connection that requires confirmation turns every entry into confirm.

read_only.description: The server's readOnlyHint. Tools without it are treated as writes.

name.description: Namespaces the tools for models as mcp__<name>__<tool>.

endpoint_url.description: Full address for integrations.manage; only the host for other viewers (the path or query may carry a token).

allow_private_network.description: Internal system switch. Works only for addresses the server operator lists in INTEGRATIONS_ALLOWED_PRIVATE_TARGETS.

agent_use_allowed.description: Released by integrations.manage for agent bindings. Off by default.

writes_require_confirmation.description: Every non read-only call waits for a person's approval, whatever the binding says. On by default.

assignable_tools.description: Tools agents may be given; null means every tool of the catalog.

secret_hint.description: Masked first header with at most its last four characters; empty for viewers without integrations.manage. Secrets are never returned.

agent_count.description: Agents whose draft or published configuration uses the connection.

headers.description: Replaces all headers; an empty object removes them. A new scheme, host or port without new headers drops the stored ones (last_error_code credentials_required) and the tool catalog.

agent_ids.description: Exactly the agents currently using the connection, as shown to the administrator. A different set is rejected with 409.

agent_use_allowed.description: Released by integrations.manage so agent builders may start an agent by this webhook. Off by default; builders list only released webhooks.

rejected_count.description: Requests without a valid signature; counted, not journaled.

trigger_count.description: Current agent triggers that start on this webhook.

IntegrationWebhookWithSecret.description: Returned only on creation and rotation; the secret is not shown again.

status.description: accepted, duplicate, or a rejection code such as invalid_signature, stale_timestamp, rate_limited.

request.description: Vendor request body without credentials; core overwrites model and streaming controls from the active run.

next_cursor.description: Present when the workspace listing has more runs.

agent_id.description: Existing agent whose draft the Architect edits; omitted for a new agent.

llm_connection_id.description: Workspace model connection; by default the first enabled one with a default model.

kind.description: `question` carries answer options; `done` means the draft is assembled.

agent_id.description: The draft agent; null until the Architect creates it.

avatar_version.description: Zero when the chat has no image.

refresh_token.description: Present only for requests sent with `X-Coma-Client: native`.

position_id.description: The position from the org structure (people only); null without one. Present when the server announces org_structure.

primary_department_id.description: The primary department (people only); null without one. Present when the server announces org_structure; the rest of the assignment is in getOrgStructure.

away.description: The person's away status («Отсутствую»), current or planned, as everyone in the workspace sees it; null without one. Present when the server announces actor_away. While it is active the status_emoji and status_text of this object carry it instead of the custom status (🌴 «В отпуске до 30 ноября»), so older clients show it too.

permissions.description: Replaces explicit permissions. The owner sets them for administrators and members. An administrator with members.manage may set only member-grantable permissions (knowledge.manage, org.manage, requests.address_groups), only for regular members other than themselves and without a role change. The server compares the old and the new set code by code: every permission the call turns on or off must be held by the administrator personally (403 forbidden otherwise); the member's other permissions are left as they are. requests.address_groups is never granted to administrators automatically; the owner always has it.

name.description: Required for groups and channels, 1 to 80 characters (Unicode code points) after trimming.

avatar_version.description: Direct chats carry the peer avatar version; group chats and channels their own image version, zero without an image (GET /api/v1/chats/{chat_id}/avatar).

last_seen_at.description: Direct chat peer only — when the person was last online, when neither side hides last seen.

last_seen_approx.description: Direct chat peer only — rough last seen used instead of last_seen_at when the person or the viewer hides the exact time.

position_id.description: The position from the org structure (people only); null without one. Present when the server announces org_structure.

primary_department_id.description: The primary department (people only); null without one. Present when the server announces org_structure; the rest of the assignment is in getOrgStructure.

away.description: The person's away status («Отсутствую»), current or planned, as everyone in the workspace sees it; null without one. Present when the server announces actor_away. While it is active the status_emoji and status_text of this object carry it instead of the custom status (🌴 «В отпуске до 30 ноября»), so older clients show it too.

voice_duration_ms.description: Set when the message is a voice recording; lists show "Voice message · 0:14".

name.description: 1 to 80 characters (Unicode code points) after trimming. A name longer than that, set before the limit, stays until renamed.

last_seen_at.description: When the person was last online. Present only for people the viewer shares this chat with, when neither of them hides last seen.

last_seen_approx.description: Rough last seen used instead of last_seen_at when the person or the viewer hides the exact time (recently means within three days).

away.description: The person's away status («Отсутствую»), current or planned, as everyone in the workspace sees it; null without one. Present when the server announces actor_away. While it is active the status_emoji and status_text of this object carry it instead of the custom status (🌴 «В отпуске до 30 ноября»), so older clients show it too.

scopes.description: Published capabilities; clients describe them in plain language.

triggers.description: Enabled triggers that can start the agent in this chat.

can_manage.description: The current actor may pause, resume and configure the agent.

command.description: Command without the leading slash (type command).

days_of_week.description: 0 is Sunday; empty means every day.

type.description: request — a request for answers («Запрос»); its body is the question and request describes the answers. task — a task («Задача», phase 6.6); its body is built by the server from the title and the description and task describes it. poll — a poll («Опрос», phase 6.7); its body is built by the server from the question and the options and poll describes it. Clients that do not know a type show the body as text.

mentioned_department_ids.description: Departments mentioned in the body (phase 6.5 wave 2). Their people who were chat members at the moment of sending or of the last edit are already in mentioned_actor_ids, which is the union of people mentioned directly and expanded departments. Absent from servers without the org_structure feature.

mentioned_departments.description: One entry per mentioned department: how many people it notified. Same for every reader; clients show the note to the author only.

thread_reply_count.description: Number of non-deleted replies when this message is a thread root.

silent.description: Present and true when the author asked for quiet notifications: recipients are notified as usual (push, e-mail digest, their own notification settings apply) but clients play no sound or vibration for it. Carried by the create response and realtime events; history pages omit it.

thread_root_reply_count.description: Realtime message.* events of a thread reply only: the current thread_reply_count of its root (zero once the root is deleted). Clients set the root's count to it instead of adding or subtracting one. History pages and other responses omit it.

truncated.description: Realtime message.* events only: the event was larger than the connection's frame limit (WS_MAX_FRAME_BYTES). The payload keeps the Message shape with ids, version, sequence, times, thread and counters but an empty body, no files and no blocks; clients load the message by REST (GET /api/v1/messages/{message_id}/context). Other event types may carry truncated: true with only their short scalar fields.

request.description: Present on messages of type request: the request as every reader sees it, without recipients or anyone's answers. Also in realtime message.* frames.

request_viewer.description: REST only (feed pages, create and context responses), next to request: what the reading person may do with it. Never in realtime frames, which the whole chat shares; clients load it with getRequest when needed.

task.description: Present on messages of type task: the whole task, the same for every reader. Also in realtime message.* frames.

poll.description: Present on messages of type poll: the poll as every reader sees it, without the counts of an open poll or anyone's choice. Also in realtime message.* frames.

poll_viewer.description: REST only (feed pages, create and context responses, «Ждут вас»), next to poll: what the reading person may see and do, with the counts when they may see the results. Never in realtime frames, which the whole chat shares; clients load it with getPoll when needed.

auto_reply.description: Present and true on an auto-reply («АВТООТВЕТ», phase 6.7): a message the server sent on behalf of its author, who is away, in a direct chat. It comes as silent and does not move the author's read cursor. Absent from servers without actor_away.

MessageAgentProvenance.description: Why an agent wrote the message. Visible to every reader of the message: it never carries a webhook payload, a follow-up note or text from another chat.

trigger_label.description: Short detail recorded when the message was written, e.g. "/summarize" or "09:00 UTC". Never a keyword pattern or a webhook name.

MessageBlocks.description: Optional structured part of an agent message. The body always carries a plain-text fallback; clients that do not support the version render the body. Server-managed state (responses, closed, binding) is part of the document so durable events carry the current card.

limit.description: per_actor lets each allowed person press once; single closes the action after the first press.

group.description: Actions of one group are a single choice per person.

binding.description: Server-only link to a domain command. tool_confirmation buttons decide an agent tool confirmation and require agents.approve.

MessageActionAudience.description: Absent audience means any active human chat member. Matching any listed actor, role or permission is enough. The server enforces it.

chunk_id.description: Knowledge fragment of a document source the answer relies on.

position.description: Position of the fragment in the document, filled by Core from chunk_id.

run_id.description: Required when authenticating with an agent API key.

blocks.description: Agent API keys with messages:interactive only. A blank body is replaced by a generated text fallback.

silent.description: Notify recipients without sound or vibration. The message and its notifications are delivered as usual and recipients' settings apply. People only: a request with an agent API key or from an agent gets 403. Absent means false.

next_cursor.description: Opaque; pass as cursor to read older attachments.

url.description: As written in the message; «www.» links get https://. Open it in a new tab or the system browser, never inline.

domain.description: Host for display: lower case, without «www.», punycode shown in Unicode (пример.рф).

label.description: Text of a markdown link «[label](url)», if any.

snippet.description: Message text around the link, whitespace folded, «…» where cut; markdown is left as written.

next_cursor.description: Opaque; pass as cursor to read older links.
Opaque; pass as cursor to read older saves.

ScheduledMessage.description: A message the current user scheduled. Visible only to its author. After sending, the text, mentions and files are cleared from the record (the message itself carries them) and message_id points to the message. Realtime events about it carry only ScheduledMessageEvent; read the record for its content.

client_msg_id.description: The idempotency key of the scheduling request. The sent message gets its own client_msg_id, derived by the server and reserved for it.

mentioned_department_ids.description: Mentioned departments, expanded into people only when the message is sent. Cleared after sending, like the other mentions. Absent from servers without the org_structure feature.

ScheduledMessageFailureReason.description: Why the message was not sent; the text stays so it can be scheduled again. author_inactive: the account was deactivated (reactivation does not revive it). security_reset: the password was changed or reset, an administrator required a new password, the e-mail changed, or every other device was signed out. session_revoked: the device that scheduled or last changed it was removed from the session list, or its refresh token was reused. Signing out on that device itself or a session expiring never stops a scheduled message. missed_send_time: it could not be sent within 15 minutes of its time. chat_unavailable: the chat was archived or deleted. not_member: the author left or was removed. forbidden: the author may no longer write here. reference_unavailable: the reply target, thread or a mentioned member is gone. attachment_unavailable: a file was deleted. invalid_content: the message no longer passes validation. delivery_error: repeated internal errors.

file_ids.description: Ready files uploaded by the current user.

send_at.description: Must be in the future and at most 365 days ahead.

silent.description: Notify recipients without sound or vibration, as for an ordinary message. Absent means false.

file_ids.description: Replaces the attachments: ready files uploaded by the current user and not attached to any other message. Files left out become unattached again and are cleaned up as usual.

ScheduledMessageEvent.description: data of the realtime events scheduled_message.created, .updated, .deleted, .sent and .failed, sent only to the author's devices. It never carries the text, mentions or files: the event log is kept long and replayed to new devices. Fetch the record when needed.

stopped_count.description: Present on the last failure event of a security stop that failed several messages at once: how many. The author gets one push for the whole stop.

RequestAnswerPreset.description: Ready-made answer types are stored as keys and translated by clients: ack «Ознакомлен(а)», yes_no «Да / Нет», attend «Приду / Не приду», done «Готово». custom carries 2–4 options written by the author.

options.description: Only for custom, and then required: 1–32 characters each, no repeats ignoring case. Omitted or empty for ready-made presets.

RequestAudienceKind.description: Whom the request asks. people and chat: any member who may write to the chat. department and position (phase 6.5 wave 2) are served by servers that announce org_structure; others answer 422 request_audience_unavailable and clients do not offer them. They need requests.address_groups in the author's effective permissions (the owner always has it) and get 403 request_audience_forbidden otherwise; the permission is checked when the request is created only.

actor_ids.description: Required for people. Intersected with the active members of the chat at the moment of sending, the author left out; an empty result gets 422 request_audience_empty.

department_id.description: Required for department. Expanded into the active people of the department and its subdepartments (primary and additional members) who are active members of the chat, the author left out. 404 department_not_found for an unknown department.

position_id.description: Required for position. Expanded into the active people with the position who are active members of the chat, the author left out. 404 position_not_found for an unknown position.

label.description: The name of the only recipient, or of the department or position, at the moment of sending; empty for chat and for several people. Never lists names. Kept when the department or position is renamed or deleted later.

count.description: Current denominator of «N из M»: recipients who are still active members of the chat plus those who answered. A recipient who left without answering drops out of it.

department_id.description: department only: the addressed department for a link to its card; null once the department is deleted. Absent for other kinds and from servers without org_structure.

position_id.description: position only: the addressed position; null once it is deleted. Absent for other kinds and from servers without org_structure.

body.description: The question; formatting and mentions work as in an ordinary message.

due_at.description: At least 10 minutes and at most 90 days ahead.

auto_remind.description: Remind those who have not answered once before the due date, at max(due_at − 24 h, created_at + (due_at − created_at) / 2). Needs due_at at least 1 hour ahead (422 request_invalid, field auto_remind, otherwise).

MessageRequest.description: The request part of a message of type request. The same for every reader: it never lists recipients or anyone's answers. Carried by the feed, createMessage-like responses and realtime message.* frames.

auto_remind_at.description: When those who have not answered get the automatic reminder; null without one.

version.description: Grows with every change of the request; realtime request.* events carry it so stale ones are dropped.

late.description: The first answer came after the due date («после срока»).

version.description: Version of the person's answer; AnswerRequestRequest.expected_version and request.answer.updated use it.

MessageRequestViewer.description: What the current person may do with a request. Never in realtime frames, which are shared by the whole chat.

role.description: observer sees «Ответа ждут не от вас» and no buttons.

can_answer.description: A recipient, the request is open, the person is in the chat and it is not archived.

can_change.description: Answered, the request is open and the due date has not passed.

can_view_answers.description: The author, a chat owner or admin, or a moderator with chats.moderate in the chat.

can_remind.description: The author, someone has not answered, 2 hours passed since the last manual reminder and fewer than 5 were sent.

next_remind_at.description: When a manual reminder is allowed again; null when it is allowed now or never again.

tally.description: Answers per option, in option order. Only with can_view_answers, null otherwise.

option.description: Index of the button; beyond the options of the request gets 422 request_invalid.

comment.description: Absent keeps the current comment, an empty string removes it. Only when the request allows comments.

expected_version.description: MessageRequestViewerAnswer.version the change is based on; another one gets 409 version_conflict.

state.description: left — the recipient answered and has left the chat since.

read.description: The recipient's read cursor reached the message («прочитал(а), не ответил(а)» against «не открывал(а) чат»).

next_cursor.description: Opaque; pass as cursor to read the next page.

reminded.description: Recipients without an answer who were reminded, including those over the daily limit who got no push.

next_cursor.description: Opaque; pass as cursor to read the next page.

remind_at.description: At least 1 minute and at most 365 days ahead.

note.description: A note for oneself. Absent keeps the current note, an empty string removes it.

Reminder.description: A personal reminder about a message. Only its owner sees it. The message is included only while the owner can read it.

message_id.description: null after the message was deleted; the reminder stays because it has a note.

late.description: Fired more than 15 minutes after remind_at (the server was down); shown as «пропущено».

access.description: available — message is filled; none — the owner cannot read the message now (left the chat, archived chat); deleted — the message was deleted. Without access only the note is shown.

next_cursor.description: Opaque; pass as cursor to read the next page.

TaskStatus.description: «Открыта», «В работе», «Готово», «Отменена». «Просрочена» is not a status: clients mark open and in_progress tasks with due_at in the past.

TaskAssigneeKind.description: person: one responsible person. department and position: a queue; nobody is responsible until a candidate takes the task.

actor_id.description: Required for person; an active person who is a member of the chat, the author included.

department_id.description: Required for department. 404 department_not_found for an unknown department.

position_id.description: Required for position. 404 position_not_found for an unknown position.

assignee_id.description: An active person who is a member of the chat.

description.description: Markdown. Mentions in it notify nobody.

due_at.description: At least 5 minutes and at most 365 days ahead. Absent — no due date.

remind_before_due.description: Remind the responsible person (the candidates of a queue) one hour before due_at. Needs due_at more than 1 hour ahead (422 task_invalid, field remind_before_due, otherwise).

source_message_id.description: «Сделать задачей»: a message of the same chat the task is made from.

expected_version.description: MessageTask.version the change is based on.

due_at.description: null removes the due date. A new one follows the rules of CreateTaskRequest.due_at.

assignee.description: A new responsible person or queue. A person may be anyone who may be responsible, a queue candidate or not. A department or position needs requests.address_groups and builds a new queue.

expected_version.description: When present, another MessageTask.version gets 409 task_version_conflict.

actor_id.description: The responsible person; null while a queue is not taken.

label.description: The name of the department or position at the moment of creation; empty for person. Kept when it is renamed or deleted.

candidate_ids.description: Queue only: the snapshot of candidates taken at creation (or at the last change to a queue). Empty for person. Stays after the task is taken.

in_chat.description: The responsible person is an active member of the chat now; false while nobody is responsible. Computed when the frame or response is built.

department_id.description: department only; null once the department is deleted. Absent for other kinds.

position_id.description: position only; null once the position is deleted. Absent for other kinds.

assignee_in_chat.description: The assignee is an active member of the chat now; false without an assignee.

excerpt.description: The start of the source text; empty once the source is deleted.

MessageTask.description: The task part of a message of type task. The same for every reader: a task has no private part. Carried by the feed, getTask, getMessageContext and realtime message.* and task.updated frames. Clients work out what the reader may do from it and their chat role; the server checks again.

source.description: «из сообщения»; null when the task was made from scratch or the source was deleted for good.

version.description: Grows with every change of the task; task.updated carries it so stale events are dropped.

TaskRole.description: Why the task is in the reader's list: responsible person, assignee of an open item, candidate of a queue, author. When several apply the first in this order wins.

mine.description: Open tasks where the reader is responsible, the assignee of an open item or a candidate of a queue nobody has taken.

mine_hot.description: Of mine, overdue or due within 24 hours.

next_cursor.description: Opaque; pass as cursor to read the next page.
Opaque; pass as cursor to read the next page.

next_nudge_at.description: When «Напомнить» is allowed again; null when the limit of 5 is reached.

TaskUpdatedEvent.description: data of the realtime task.updated event (the realtime schema keeps its top level, this type describes task). Sent to the whole chat on every change of a task except its title and description (message.updated): status, due date, responsible person, items, taking, nudges, the overdue mark. Clients replace the cached task when version is greater.

WaitingInboxItem.description: One item of «Ждут вас». kind request: request and viewer are set, my_role is null; the same data as RequestInboxItem. kind task: the task is message.task, request and viewer are null and my_role says why the reader sees it (never author). kind poll (servers with message_polls): the poll is message.poll and the reader's state is message.poll_viewer; request, viewer and my_role are null. Clients skip kinds they do not know.

due_at.description: The due date the list is ordered by.

next_cursor.description: Opaque; pass as cursor to read the next page.

options.description: 1–100 characters each, no repeats ignoring case.

multiple.description: «Несколько ответов» — a vote may choose several options, with no upper limit.

anonymous.description: Nobody, the author and workspace admins included, can learn who chose what: the server stores only the counts per option and who has voted. A vote in an anonymous poll cannot be changed or retracted.

due_at.description: When the poll closes by itself; at least 10 minutes and at most 90 days ahead. Absent — open until closed by hand.

MessagePoll.description: The poll part of a message of type poll. The same for every reader: it never carries the counts of an open poll or anyone's choice, so it is also in realtime message.* frames. The counts of an open poll are only in PollViewer.counts of those who may see the results.

question.description: The author may edit it with updatePoll while the poll is open (message edited_at); options, flags and due_at never change.

voter_count.description: N of «N из M» — people who have voted, including those who have left the chat since.

member_count.description: M of «N из M». An ordinary poll: active people of the chat now (agents left out) plus voters who have left. An anonymous poll: active people of the chat now, never fewer than voter_count, so a change of M never tells whether the person who left had voted.

final_counts.description: Votes per option, in option order. Only on a closed poll; always null while it is open.

version.description: Grows with every change of the poll (votes, closing, the denominator, an edit of the question); poll.updated carries it so stale events are dropped.

PollViewer.description: What the current person may see and do with a poll. REST only (Message.poll_viewer in feed pages, create and context responses, getPoll, votePoll, closePoll); never in realtime frames, which the whole chat shares.

my_options.description: The person's choice in an ordinary poll; null before the vote and always null in an anonymous poll (clients keep it on the device only).

can_vote.description: An active person of the chat, the poll open and the chat not archived; in an anonymous poll also not voted yet.

can_change.description: An ordinary poll the person has voted in, still open; covers both a new choice and «Отменить голос».

can_view_results.description: Voted, the author, or the poll is closed. There is no way to see the results without voting.

can_view_voters.description: can_view_results and the poll is not anonymous — avatars at the options and listPollVoters by option.

can_view_waiting.description: The author or a chat owner or admin or a moderator with chats.moderate in the chat, and the poll is not anonymous — listPollVoters with filter=waiting.

can_close.description: The poll is open and the person is its author still in the chat, or a chat owner or admin or a moderator with chats.moderate in it.

can_remind.description: The author, the poll open, someone has not voted, 2 hours passed since the last reminder and fewer than 5 were sent.

next_remind_at.description: When a reminder is allowed again; null when it is allowed now or never again.

counts.description: Votes per option, in option order. Only with can_view_results, null otherwise.

expected_version.description: MessagePoll.version the edit is based on; another one gets 409 version_conflict.

options.description: Indexes of the chosen options; exactly one unless the poll is multiple. An index beyond the options gets 422 poll_invalid. Use retractPollVote to remove a vote.

expected_version.description: MessagePoll.version the change is based on; another one gets 409 version_conflict. Optional.

voted_at.description: When the person voted; null in the waiting list.

in_chat.description: false — the voter has left the chat since («не в чате»); the vote stays in the count.

next_cursor.description: Opaque; pass as cursor to read the next page.

reminded.description: People without a vote who were reminded, including those over the daily limit who got no push.

AwayKind.description: vacation «В отпуске» 🌴, appointment «На приёме» 🩺, trip «На выезде» 🚗, dnd «Не беспокоить» 🔕, other ⏸ with the person's own label. Clients translate the kinds; only other carries text.

AwayPublic.description: An away status («Отсутствую», phase 6.7) as everyone in the workspace sees it. Never carries the auto-reply text, mute_push or a substitute others must not see; the owner gets those in AwayStatus (GET /api/v1/me/away).

label.description: The own text of kind other; empty for the other kinds.

active.description: starts_at <= now < ends_at at the moment the response or the event was made; clients recheck it against the clock.

substitute_id.description: Whom to write instead; null without one and while the substitute is deactivated or away themselves (checked on every read).

notifications_off.description: Push is off while the status is active: the mention hint says «уведомление не придёт».

text.description: Sent once to each person who writes to the owner in a direct chat during the period, as the owner's message with auto_reply. Required (1–500 characters) when enabled; kept when disabled.

AwayStatus.description: The away status as its owner sees it (getAway, setAway). Only the owner ever gets autoreply, mute_push and the substitute as saved; everyone else gets AwayPublic.

label.description: The own text of kind other; empty for the other kinds.

active.description: starts_at <= now < ends_at at the moment of the response.

substitute_id.description: The substitute as saved, also when others do not see them now (deactivated or away themselves).

notifications_off.description: Equals mute_push; kept so AwayStatus has every AwayPublic field.

mute_push.description: «Не присылать уведомления» while the status is active: no push and no e-mail digest, except the person's own reminders and direct messages from the workspace owner and admins, which come without sound. Badges and counters work as usual.

label.description: Required (1–40 characters) for other; must be absent or empty for the other kinds.

starts_at.description: Absent — now. At most 365 days ahead; a time in the past is taken as now.

ends_at.description: Later than starts_at and at most 180 days after it.

substitute_id.description: An active person of the workspace, not the person themselves and not an agent. Absent or null — no substitute.

expected_version.description: AwayStatus.version the change is based on; another one gets 409 away_version_conflict. Optional.

actor_id.description: The person who is away and named the current person as substitute.

lead_actor_id.description: The lead, always a member of the department; null without one or while the lead is not active.

chat_id.description: The department chat, only when the reader is a member of it; null otherwise.

has_chat.description: The department has a linked chat, whether or not the reader is a member.

chat_archived.description: The linked chat is archived («Чат в архиве»); false without a chat.

sort_key.description: Manual order among siblings; null — by name until the first manual move.

OrgPerson.description: The org assignment of one active person.

additional_department_ids.description: Oldest membership first. Empty without a primary department.

version.description: Grows by one with every write of the structure; org.updated carries it.

people.description: Active people with a membership or a position; everyone else has none.

primary.description: true moves the person's primary department here; false adds it as an additional one.

members.description: Each person at most once (422 org_invalid).

UpdateDepartmentRequest.description: Fields left out are not changed.

parent_id.description: null moves the department to the top level.

version.description: The org version after the write.

keep_previous.description: With primary true — keep the previous primary department as an additional one instead of leaving it.

expected_org_version.description: The org version the client saw; 409 org_version_conflict when the structure changed since.

skipped.description: Names left out because a position with that name exists or the name repeats.

actor_ids.description: Active people whose title it is; candidates for the position once created.

notified_count.description: Active people of the department and its subdepartments who are members of the chat, the author left out, at the moment of sending or of the last edit. Clients show «Уведомлены N человек» to the author only.

MentionedDepartmentIds.description: Departments mentioned with the same token as a person, @[Name](department id). The server expands each into the active people of the department and its subdepartments who are members of the chat, without the author, and adds them to mentioned_actor_ids. More than 10 get 422 validation_failed (details.field mentioned_department_ids). A department id sent in mentioned_actor_ids by an older client is moved here instead of being rejected. Servers without the org_structure feature reject the unknown field, so clients send it only when the server announces the feature.

requests_waiting.description: Open requests in the chat waiting for the person's answer. Absent on servers without message_requests.

requests_next_due_at.description: The earliest due date among them; null when none has one.

tasks_mine_open.description: Open tasks in the chat where the person is responsible, the assignee of an open item or a candidate of a queue nobody has taken. Absent on servers without message_tasks.

tasks_mine_next_due_at.description: The earliest due date among them; null when none has one.

polls_waiting.description: Open polls with a due date in the chat the person may vote in and has not voted in. Absent on servers without message_polls. The chat list shows no mark for them.

requests_waiting_total.description: Requests waiting for the person's answer in all chats («Ждут вас»). Absent on servers without message_requests.

reminders_fired_total.description: Fired reminders the person has not closed yet. Absent on servers without message_reminders.

tasks_mine_open_total.description: Open tasks of the person in all chats («Ждут вас»): responsible, assignee of an open item or candidate of a queue nobody has taken. Absent on servers without message_tasks.

tasks_mine_hot_total.description: Of tasks_mine_open_total, those overdue or due within 24 hours: the badge of «Важные» counts only these. Absent on servers without message_tasks.

polls_waiting_total.description: Open polls with a due date in all chats the person may vote in and has not voted in («Ждут вас»). Absent on servers without message_polls.

polls_hot_total.description: Of polls_waiting_total, those due within 24 hours: the badge of «Важные» counts only these. Absent on servers without message_polls.

mobile_relay_url.description: Push relay this instance sends mobile notifications through; empty when mobile push is off. Apps register only with the relay they were built for.

url.description: Short-lived object-store URL, or an API path when `authenticated` is true.

authenticated.description: The URL is an API path that needs the bearer token.

notification_key.description: Base64 of the 32-byte AES-256-GCM key the app decrypts notifications with.

last_seen_visibility.description: Who sees when this person was last online. "nobody" also hides other people's exact time from them (symmetric, as in Telegram); online status itself stays visible in the workspace.
